summary: Family firm, 55 staff, EUR 6.41 M turnover; we are 3.64 % of it. In distress: credit index 230 -> 302, short-time work, bank watching monthly, MD 'cannot sign anything that lowers our margin now'. Second shift idle, owner offered open book. Sole active source of pump shaft HN 32 mm (33.06); sup:70210 is qualified with free capacity. Trade truly valuable fast payment for price, use the open book, avoid a supplier collapse.
